identity.description: Divide mesh faces to form a smooth surface, using the Catmull-Clark subdivision method

enum_items.name: None
enum_items.description: UVs are not smoothed, boundaries are kept sharp

enum_items.name: Keep Corners
enum_items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary are kept sharp

enum_items.name: Keep Corners, Junctions
enum_items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary and junctions of 3 or more regions are kept sharp

enum_items.name: Keep Corners, Junctions, Concave
enum_items.description: UVs are smoothed, corners on discontinuous boundary, junctions of 3 or more regions and darts and concave corners are kept sharp

enum_items.name: Keep Boundaries
enum_items.description: UVs are smoothed, boundaries are kept sharp

enum_items.name: Keep Corners
enum_items.description: Smooth boundaries, but corners are kept sharp
